defect_assertion: is_discount_eligible performs a linear membership scan over discount_list (a plain list) on every call, and tag_eligible_customers calls it once per customer inside its loop, so the overall cost is O(len(customers) times len(discount_list)) even though the code looks clean via the named helper function; extracting a linear scan into a well-named helper function does not change its algorithmic complexity. Converting discount_list to a set once before the loop would make each check O(1) and the whole function linear.
